# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Improved the habitat/geometry biofilter probe reporting so runs that never clear reduced nitrogen no longer print ambiguous `None` values. The probe now formats clearance as `not-cleared` and explicitly notes when the terminal reduced-nitrogen fallback check was used in both the per-probe debug line and the aggregate summary output.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the latest approved findings and isolated the remaining actionable issue as a readability gap in the biofilter probe's clearance summary.
2. [Completed] Added a small clearance-formatting helper and wired it into the biofilter probe's detailed metrics line and aggregate observed summary so non-clearing runs are described explicitly.
3. [Completed] Reformatted the workspace and reran targeted habitat/geometry validation plus clippy for the affected test target.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary -- --nocapture` passed: the summary test was green and still reported all 5 habitat/geometry probes passing.
- The updated biofilter output now reads `clearance not-cleared->not-cleared (terminal reduced-N fallback)` when neither arm clears within the horizon, removing the prior ambiguous `None` reporting.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- -D warnings` completed successfully.

## Outstanding Risks

- This pass only changed probe/reporting text; validation was targeted to the affected habitat/geometry test target plus clippy, not the full workspace test matrix.
- The worktree already contains unrelated existing changes in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7`, `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs`, and `.ralph-burning/`; I left them untouched, so staging/commit flow still needs to avoid mixing scopes.
